title: ESB latency spike at 18:09 UTC (fault 126)
query: The ESB service is showing elevated response times starting around 18:09 UTC on 2020-05-25. Success rate may have dropped. Investigate the root cause and identify which component is responsible.

title: Intermittent ESB failures between 19:40–20:20 UTC (faults 129–130)
query: We have multiple ESB degradation reports between 19:40 and 20:20 UTC on 2020-05-25. Failures appear intermittent. Investigate whether this is a single root cause or multiple independent issues.

title: JDBC timeout investigation
query: Engineers are reporting slow database queries. Trace data suggests JDBC calls are occasionally taking hundreds of milliseconds. Find which database node is the bottleneck and what infrastructure metric explains it.

title: Full incident timeline reconstruction (all faults on May 25 2020)
query: Give me a full timeline of all known incidents on 2020-05-25 (UTC). For each fault window, confirm whether the ESB service degraded and identify the most likely root cause from the telemetry.

title: Docker container health during degradation
query: During the ESB degradation windows on 2020-05-25, I want to know if any Docker containers showed abnormal CPU or thread pool usage. Identify the most stressed container and its host OS node.
